_comment: The spa reminder's words and its state, as every reader must give them.
The phone_cases.json pattern: spaBookingText and spaReminderText in
nala-shared.js and their twins in worker/send-invites.js answer to `text`;
spaReminderState answers to `state`. tests/spar_suite.py runs the page's
copies, worker/invites-test.mjs the Worker's. Add a case here, not to a
suite: a case added here fails whichever copy has not learned it.
`now` is a LOCAL time, built in the zone the suite runs in, because a
treatment starts at the resort's clock and staff devices live there.
`horizon` is how many days ahead a reminder can go, today counted: the
owner's 28 Sep ask for Pre-arrival SMS's 3, 7 and 14 day looks. The
page's SPA_REMIND_DAYS and the Worker's SPA_AHEAD_DAYS both answer to it.

state.name: never sent, a mobile, before it starts
an overseas mobile is sendable
a landline cannot be sent to
no number at all
started without a text: late, nothing to do
the minute it starts counts as started
a minute before it starts is still owed
a text that went, quoting it as it stands
sent stays sent once it has started
sent stays sent whatever the number now says
delivered is sent
moved since its text: owed again
a new length since its text: owed again
moved, and it has started: late
moved, and the number is gone: cannot send
a send that failed is still to send
a text the handset never got is still to send
a leftover second length on one massage is not a change
a record with no time is never late
tomorrow's treatment is not late today
a text sent days early, quoting it as it stands
moved after a text sent early: owed again
